listing.name: OpenRCT2
listing.summary: OpenRCT2 offers upstream packages for RollerCoaster Tycoon 2. Follow upstream setup before registering your executable.

steps.title: Start the game
steps.instruction: On first Play, select your installed RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 files if they are not detected. Optional RollerCoaster Tycoon 1 files can be configured through upstream menus. This is the standalone portable engine; the separate upstream auto-updating launcher remains an external alternative.

references.title: Use OpenRCT2 on Mac
references.instruction: For a managed copy on Intel or Apple Silicon, use Portcove Install and then Play. OpenRCT2 can ask you to select your installed RCT2 files on first Play. Keep your original files and the OpenRCT2 profile under ~/Library/Application Support/OpenRCT2. Portcove manages the bundle and leaves that profile under your ownership. The inspected upstream build declares macOS 10.14 or later on Intel and 11 or later on Apple Silicon. Portcove has its own OS requirements. For a separately maintained copy or a custom profile location, download the official macos-universal ZIP, extract the full OpenRCT2.app bundle and use upstream setup.

references.title: Use the external Windows ARM64 or Linux package
references.instruction: Choose the official Windows portable ARM64 ZIP on Windows ARM64. Keep the entire folder with openrct2.exe. On Linux, use the upstream x86-64 AppImage or the Flatpak documented by OpenRCT2. Follow upstream to select your original data. Preserve the actual OpenRCT2 profile before upgrading. Keep package-manager or upstream updates separate from a Portcove installation.

references.title: Set up OpenRCT2 on Android
references.instruction: Use the upstream Android APK for Android 7 or newer on arm64, ARMv7 or x86-64. Copy your installed RCT2 data to the shared-storage rct2 folder. The app requests All files access on Android 11 and later, or storage permission on older Android, for the original files and its openrct2 profile. Back up that profile and your originals. Follow upstream to install or update the app with the same Android package identity and signer.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, select your installed RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 files if they are not detected. Optional RollerCoaster Tycoon 1 files can be configured through upstream menus. This is the standalone portable engine; the separate upstream auto-updating launcher remains an external alternative. Settings, saves, custom objects, tracks, replays and downloaded content normally live in Documents/OpenRCT2, outside Portcove backups. Original installations remain external. No in-folder player data is declared for this default mode. Register an external copy for custom --user-data-path or the separate auto-updating launcher. Existing external installations keep their files and runtime update owner. Gameplay, platform minimums and packaged Desktop acceptance remain separate observations. The Linux recommendation is upstream’s Debian Bookworm build, not an interchangeable build for every distribution. It requires the corresponding SDL2, ICU72, OpenSSL3, curl/font libraries and other upstream runtime dependencies. Keep libopenrct2.so with the player. User configuration and saves normally remain in OpenRCT2’s external XDG user directory, outside Portcove backups. Other distribution packages remain upstream alternatives. Core extraction, published SHA-256 comparison and ELF/dependency inspection passed on Windows. Linux execution, minimum-environment and gameplay observations remain Not run. On Intel and Apple Silicon Mac, the standalone bundle reads and writes your OpenRCT2 profile in the actual account’s Library/Application Support/OpenRCT2 folder. Keep that folder outside managed runtime locations. Use a separately prepared copy when you need custom profile arguments.
